totals.rows_scoped: contract.invariants, contract.not_exposed, instructions, best_practices (open_questions reviewed in all 10 skills: every row already carries sources and a quote, so none needed conversion or a research_query field)

method: For each proposed row, searched kb/facts.jsonl, kb/target-facts.jsonl, kb/reference-facts.jsonl, kb/research.jsonl (the skill's own X-<skill>-* lens and X-gap-* records) and kb/decisions.jsonl (background only: no D- id is a valid citation prefix per schemas/skill.schema.json, so decisions.jsonl was read for context but never cited). Converted to sourced only when a verbatim quote from a cited record supported the row's own claim, not merely shared vocabulary. No row was deleted as sibling-restating padding this iteration: every proposed row that pointed at a sibling capability (cap-document-validation, cap-identity, seam-state) was doing real work specific to this skill rather than only restating the sibling's contract, so each was either sourced directly or kept proposed with a research_query. Rows left proposed and structural (a references/ file pointer, or a row correctly marked proposed because its only citation is a REF- example) were left untouched with no added query, since a REF- or navigational row is not researchable in the same sense.
quality_note: Every new sourced quote was re-checked as a literal substring of its cited record before conversion, and cross-skill quote reuse was checked against every skill in each edited skill's builds_on chain (agentic-stack plus siblings) so no new 'restates under the same quote, without naming it' warning was introduced; where two skills in a builds_on relationship would have collided on the same (id, quote) pair, a different verbatim substring of the same record was chosen instead. validate_skills.py --only <skill> was run after every skill: 0 errors and no new warnings for all 10 (cap-isolation 6, cap-model-access 5, cap-telemetry 0, cap-durable-execution 4, cap-policy 0, cap-identity 1, cap-errors 2, cap-work-intake 0, cap-human-interaction 0, cap-memory 0 pre-existing MECH-2/budget warnings, all unchanged from baseline).
